titulo: Degree in Physical Activity and Sport Sciences
equivalencia: 240 ECTS credits · MECES level 2 and level 6 of the European Qualifications Framework (EQF). Equivalent to a Bachelor of Science (BSc) in Sport and Exercise Sciences.

titulo: Master’s in Sport Performance: Talent Development and Elite Level (RETAN)
equivalencia: Official university master’s degree · MECES level 3 and EQF level 7. Equivalent to a Master of Science (MSc) in Sport Performance, academically valid throughout the European Union.

titulo: Master’s in Secondary Education Teacher Training, specialising in Physical Education
equivalencia: Official 60-ECTS university master’s degree · MECES level 3 and EQF level 7. It is the qualification that licenses secondary school teaching in Spain, comparable to a PGCE-type teacher training qualification.

titulo: European University Diploma in Adapted Physical Activity (EUDAPA)
centro: Haaga-Helia University of Applied Sciences · Vierumäki, Finland
equivalencia: European 60-ECTS programme coordinated by Haaga-Helia, with an on-site intensive period in Vierumäki (Finland).

detalle: Running and operating a sports centre, and training methodologies. Non-accredited training.
